# Controller-stage qualification plan — 2026-09-14

Reuse `_scratch/startup-authority-qualification-proposal01`:
`qualify_windows_reservations.py` (`4c057e43`), `run_preflight01.ps1`
(`00b0dab5`), PINS `47af697a` and EXPECTED `2dc0ec32`. Its 21 modules,
23 child texts and 27 parent inputs are the baseline. Full hashes and paths
are in SOURCE-BINDINGS.json. This plan creates no instrument or admission.

1. **Source closure.** Keep canonical adapter `635d2c22`, resolver
   `16a5a124`, durable lifecycle `3c8963ea` and other retained inputs.
   Replace only the isolated `startup_fixture_adapter` with the frozen stage
   derivative, proving its entire 28,922-byte `6482b782` prefix unchanged.
   The author proposes `worker_stage_fixture`, then
   `test_controller_worker_stage`, appended after the existing modules.
   Their listed imports are already loaded, including `_DurableKernel`;
   no preload or guard expansion is needed. Final hashes/counts remain pending.
   Saved native delegate references do not justify replacing these inputs.

2. **Authority checks.** Preserve the temporary resolver alias and its
   `finally` restoration before test definitions. Both canonical and isolated
   pairs must start and finish closed. Keep all 36 existing function captures
   and append the frozen stage-check functions to that identity check; bind the
   resulting exact count. Preserve all real-entry refusals.

3. **Cases.** Keep the complete ordered 81-ID list as the prefix of EXPECTED
   and all three old test files plus the startup fixture byte-identical.
   Append only the author's frozen new IDs, using the existing explicit
   `loadTestsFromName(relative, LOADED[module])` selector. Recompute the finite
   module/input/case counts and parent pins after freeze. Generated39 assertions
   remain unchanged outside this union. Do not load the failed child delivery
   or its 17 proposed tests.

4. **Guards and receipts.** Retain the ten guards, built-in registry identity
   and traps, 12 metadata traps, closed content/import boundary and heavy-root
   refusals. Keep 1 MiB/input, 8,192 characters/capture, 64 subtests/case and
   262,144-byte result bounds. Require exact ordered cases, no failures/skips,
   empty captures/stderr/denials, unchanged source/copy/control bytes, and actual
   zero child and outer exits. Preserve immediate LASTEXITCODE capture,
   native-exit, plan, stdout/stderr, input-check and exit records.

5. **Two copies.** Propose fresh labels `controller-stage-fake01` and
   `controller-stage-confirmation01`. After source/instrument review, each
   needs its own false template and recomputed PINS before root admission.
   Confirmation preserves child bytes; only required label/path/control
   bindings differ. The retained command is `C:\Python314\python.exe -I -S -B`;
   set lexical IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE before the PowerShell host starts. Save each
   exact exec/poll result outside admitted inputs. Pre-try setup failures do
   not guarantee launch-failure.json; their actual outer result is essential.

The new controls must reach finish-start and published stages through the
unchanged factory, with fixed inert services. They cannot establish actual
Windows resume, job/read-set ownership, pipe authentication or model authority.
Source hashes, stage-function names and final case membership await freeze;
root and peer review precede any separate execution decision.
